subtitle: Fuel Tracker & Car Maintenance
promotionalText: Real MPG from every fill-up, gas spending by month, and oil change reminders — free, no account, and your data exports to CSV anytime.
description:
Know your real gas mileage — and never miss an oil change.

Glance MPG is a simple, fast fuel and maintenance log. No account, no subscription, no pop-up ads while you type at the pump.

■ LOG A FILL-UP IN 10 SECONDS
Odometer, gallons and price — enter any two of gallons, price and total and the third fills in. See this tank's MPG before you even save.

■ ACCURATE MPG
MPG is measured from one full tank to the next. Partial fill-ups are added to the next full tank, and if you forgot to log one, flip "Missed logging a fill-up" so your average stays right. Use the odometer or your trip meter.

■ SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES
Fuel economy trend, spending by month (fuel and service), the gas price you paid, cost per mile, best and worst tank — for 3 months, 6 months, a year or all time.

■ MAINTENANCE REMINDERS
Oil change, tire rotation, brakes, filters, inspection, registration — or anything you name. Set a distance, a number of months, or both. Log the service and the reminder starts over. Distance reminders estimate the date from your own driving and notify you.

■ YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Export everything to a CSV file for free, anytime. Import CSV files from a backup or from other fuel log apps (columns like Date, Odometer, Gallons, Price are matched automatically). Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

■ ALSO
• Unlimited vehicles
• Road trip gas cost split per person
• Miles or kilometers, gallons or liters, MPG, L/100 km or km/L
• Service and other costs: insurance, parking, tolls, car wash, repairs
• Light and dark mode, large text friendly

Your log is stored only on your iPhone (and in your iPhone's own backup). Before switching phones, export a CSV and import it on the new one.
reviewNotes:
Gas mileage and car maintenance log. No account or login; all data is stored locally on the device. Network requests are only Google AdMob banner ads.
Notifications: maintenance reminders are scheduled locally (permission is asked when the user saves their first reminder).
To try it quickly: enter a car name, tap Fill-up, enter odometer 10000, gallons 12, price 3.25, Save; then Fill-up again with odometer 10300, gallons 10, total 35 → the log shows 30.0 MPG.
